title: The Jackal and the Leopard
notes:
Rodiya. North-western Province.


Part of this story was given in The Orientalist, vol. iv, p. 30. A
Jackal that had followed a Leopard which was trying to get at a man
who had taken refuge in a corn store, advised it to insert its tail
through a gap in the doorway, and wave it about. When it did so,
the Jackal said in the Peraelibasa, [145] which the Leopard did not
understand, Katu anuwe potun detak, which when transposed becomes
atu kanuwe detun potak, "Two or three twists round the pillar of the
corn store." The man acted as advised, and held the tail fast. When
some men came up they killed the Leopard.
text:
In a certain country there is a Gamarala. There is a goat-fold of the
Gamarala's. At that goat-fold one by one the goats are disappearing
during the night. Afterwards the Gamarala having gone there [to watch
for the thief] went to sleep. In the hand of the Gamarala there was
a lump of salt chillies.

Afterwards the Leopard came at night. The Leopard lifting each goat
looks at it. Having looked, afterwards having lifted up the Gamarala
[and found he was the heaviest] he took him. Carrying him away he took
him to his rock cave. Then the Gamarala quickly [entered it, and] shut
the door. The Leopard then was trying to go into the cave. Having heard
the uproar the Jackal Panditaya came. "What is this, Sapu-flowers'
Minister, you are doing?" he asked.

"In other years I brought goats [and ate them without trouble]. That
one having entered the cave has shut the door."

"You, Sir, having put your tail inside the cave be pleased to wave it,"
he said; the Jackal Panditaya said. "Do not catch hold of the tail,"
he said [to the Gamarala]. "Otherwise, having put thy foot against the
wall, and having folded it two-fold or three-fold, hold it [fast],"
he said. "Do not jam a little of the golden salt chillies under the
tail of the Sapu-flowers' Minister," he said.

Then the Gamarala having seized the tail jammed in the salt
chillies. Afterwards the Sapu-flowers' Minister pulling out his tail
bounded away. Having bounded off and gone, he sat down on a flat
rock. Afterwards the Jackal Panditaya asked, "What are you on that
flat rock for?"

"I am looking if this country is fruitful or unfruitful," [144]
he said.

Again, the Gamarala, saving his life, went to the village. The Jackal
Panditaya went to the Gamarala. "What is it, Gamarala? Couldn't you
kill him?"

"While he was outside how could I, sitting in the cave, kill him?"

"I will tell you a trick for that one," the Jackal Panditaya
said. Afterwards he said, "You must make a trap for that one," he said.

"Where shall I make the trap?" [the Gamarala] asked.

"At the fence of the goat-fold," he said.

Afterwards he made the trap. The Sapu-flowers' Minister was noosed
in the trap. On the following day the Gamarala came to look. Having
come before the Gamarala, also the Jackal Panditaya came near the
trap. "Gamarala, to-day indeed he has been hanged," he said.

    Etana metana to gasanne
    Kambul baeta dipanne
    Kanda sewanata aedapanne

    "Strike thou there and here a blow;
    Knocks upon the cheeks bestow;
    Drag him to the hill's shadow,"

the Jackal Panditaya said.

    Hampottayi to ganne
    Malu tika mata denne.

Then he said--

    "'Tis the skin will be for thee,
    The little flesh thou'lt give to me."

ある国にガマラーラ(村長)がいる。ガマラーラの山羊小屋がある。その山羊小屋から、夜のあいだに山羊が一頭ずつ消えてゆく。そこでガマラーラは〔盗人を見張りに〕そこへ行って、眠り込んだ。ガマラーラの手には塩唐辛子の塊があった。
そのあと夜に豹が来た。豹は山羊を一頭ずつ持ち上げて見る。見てから、そのあとガマラーラを持ち上げて〔いちばん重いとわかり〕、それを担いだ。運び去って自分の岩屋へ連れていった。するとガマラーラはすばやく〔なかに入って〕戸を閉めた。豹は洞穴に入ろうとした。その騒ぎを聞きつけて豺のパンディタヤ(学者)が来た。「どうなさいました、サプの花の大臣どの?」と尋ねた。
「これまでの年は山羊を運んで〔苦もなく食べて〕きた。あいつが洞穴に入って戸を閉めてしまったのだ」
「旦那さま、尻尾を洞穴のなかへ差し入れて、どうか振ってごらんなさい」と豺のパンディタヤは言った。「尻尾をつかんではいけませんぞ」と〔ガマラーラに〕言った。「でなければ、足を壁に当てて、尻尾を二重にも三重にも折り曲げて、しっかり握るのです」と言った。「サプの花の大臣どのの尻尾の下に、あの黄金の塩唐辛子を少しでも詰め込んではいけませんぞ」と言った。
するとガマラーラは尻尾をつかんで、塩唐辛子を詰め込んだ。そのあとサプの花の大臣は尻尾を引き抜いて跳ね去った。跳ねて去っていって、平らな岩の上に坐った。そのあと豺のパンディタヤが尋ねた。「その平らな岩の上で何をしておいでです?」
「この国が実り豊かか不毛かを眺めているのだ」 [144] と豹は言った。
一方ガマラーラは命拾いして村へ帰った。豺のパンディタヤはガマラーラのもとへ行った。「どうしました、ガマラーラどの。殺せませんでしたか?」
「あれが外にいるのに、わしが洞穴のなかに坐っていてどうして殺せよう」
「あれを捕らえる手を教えましょう」と豺のパンディタヤは言った。そしてこう言った。「あれのために罠を仕掛けるのです」と言った。
「どこに罠を仕掛ける?」と〔ガマラーラが〕尋ねた。
「山羊小屋の垣に」と豺は言った。
そのあとガマラーラは罠を仕掛けた。サプの花の大臣は罠にかかって吊るされた。翌日ガマラーラが見に来た。ガマラーラより先に、豺のパンディタヤも罠のそばへ来ていた。「ガマラーラどの、今日こそあれは吊るされましたぞ」と言った。
エタナ メタナ ト ガサンネ カンブル バエタ ディパンネ カンダ セワナタ アエダパンネ
「あちらこちらを打ちすえよ、頬にげんこつ食らわせよ、丘の陰まで引きずれよ」
と豺のパンディタヤは言った。
ハンポッタヤイ ト ガンネ マル ティカ マタ デンネ。
そして言った——
「皮はおまえのものとなり、わずかな肉はわたしにおくれ」
